title: Spinach on the Clock
caption: Fridgeroo pings you the evening before your food goes off, so the spinach gets eaten, not binned 🥬 Free at fridgeroo.netlify.app, no download needed.
why: Fixes "Not sure whats going on": one clear story, no in-jokes or Dutch. The hook states the problem in plain English (spinach, 3 days left). The countdown shows the days ticking 3-2-1 while green turns amber turns red, then a phone notification reads 'Spinach goes off tomorrow!' and the end text says 'Spinach saved.' It copies the founder's favourite countdown example. New sequence hook→countdown→end, not used in the last 6.
